title: Zung Kau Chun

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No.
Dat. 11-1-16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

January 11th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
The midshipman named Zung Kau Chun 陳可勤 who was alleged to be the leader of the attack on the cruiser Chaoho was shot at the Arsenal at 2 p.m. yesterday.

It is reported that General Yang has received a code telegram from the Central Government saying that Tuan Ji Zay 段祺瑞 had fled from Peking and instructing the General to keep a sharp lookout for him. Another report says that Tuan did not leave Peking but was assassinated there by Yuan Shih Kai's agents.

At 11 a.m. 10th inst a fire accidently broke out in Tsang Dong Zung 張同順 cracker shop in the City. The blaze was extinguished before any serious damage had been done.

It is now definitely known that the men who were arrested at Zau Woo Kyung 邹伍经 Loonghwo are robbers.

Entered on ms. Jan. 11
Seen by C S P

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmmmmshing
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记
编号
日期：16年1月11日

上海工部局。

1916年1月11日

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

据称是袭击“巢湖”号巡洋舰主谋的海军少尉陈可勤（Zung Kau Chun），于昨日下午2时在兵工厂被枪决。

据悉，杨将军收到中央政府发来的密电，称段祺瑞（Tuan Ji Zay）已逃离北京，并指示将军严密监视其行踪。另有消息称，段并未离开北京，而是在北京被袁世凯的代理人暗杀。

本月10日上午11时，城内张同顺（Tsang Dong Zung）爆竹店意外发生火灾。火势在造成严重损失前已被扑灭。

现已确切查明，在邹伍经（Zau Woo Kyung）龙活（Loonghwo）被捕之人系劫匪。

录入手稿时间：1月11日
C S P 阅

您的恭顺仆人，

mmmmmmmmshing
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监上尉。
